defect_class: scenario coverage — the plan names a specification file that is not the one it was given
construction: `feature_files:` points at features/member-directory/member-directory.feature. Every scenario is still stamped, and the titles are still verbatim.
why_this_one_matters: The declared path is what the coverage claim is measured against. guardkit refuses a declared file that does not exist in the repo; forge refuses a plan whose declaration contradicts the specification it committed. A map keyed to the wrong file is a coverage claim about some other feature.
